functions.name: Com_EventLoop
functions.evidence: String 'Com_EventLoop: oversize packet\n'; "\025Com_EventLoop: bad event type %i". Q3 Com_EventLoop: an empty event first drains loopback packets for socket 1 (into a 0x20000-byte temporary message buffer) and returns that event's time. Type 4 = console command text, appended to the command buffer plus "\n"; type 5 = packet whose payload follows a 0x14-byte netadr. Packets are delivered via fn_080960e2 only while com_sv_running is set. Returns the time of the terminating empty event.

open_questions: Trace contexts (SegQueryA/B, SegHitTrace, BoxQueryTrace, BoxHitTrace) share no common base layout in this chunk; the earlier-chunk allocators are needed to identify the real structs (invDelta at +0x18 in SegQueryB vs extents at +0x18 in the box traces).
Semantics of the two entry lists per SpatialNode (entryHead@8 here, entryHeadAlt@0xa in fn_0805ecd4) and what g_spatialEntries represent.
Com_ErrorRecover (0x08060fa2) caller 0x080627f4 and roles of fn_080ac5ee/fn_080b1250/fn_08065d9a/fn_0808002c; dvar 0x081a218c is named com_sv_running by usage only.
Cmd_PrintArgs_f (0x08060196) is not registered by Cmd_Init; the command name registering it is unknown (echo?).
Duplicate function pairs (Cmd_Argc/_alt, Cmd_Argv/_alt, tokenizers, Com_ServerShutdown/_alt) are probably separate translation units; their owning modules are unknown.
